For a finite census the new coarse factors are Q i(1 + ziQi). A multi-index coefficient is the subset sum over slots taken from these factors, all others supplied by the transported negative fine observable. Finite coefficient extraction commutes with every RG push by linearity and integrability. This sum is exactly the joint fine/coarse difference polynomial. Integration of the push preserves its integral; restoration of the coupling gives the positive Wilson partition function times the discrepancy moment. Thus the root extraction compares this actual local difference in its original normalization.
